Based on a chapter from Disasters By Design: How Engineering Failures Shaped the Modern World by Grady Hillhouse.
US: https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/786143/disasters-by-design-by-grady-hillhouse/
UK: https://www.penguin.co.uk/books/476190/disasters-by-design-by-hillhouse-grady/9780241798508
More About the Book: https://practical.engineering/books

What happened in New Orleans in August 2005 wasn’t a natural disaster. A number of engineering errors made the hurricane far more deadly than it would have been otherwise. And I built a model to show you why.

Watch this video ad-free on Nebula: https://nebula.tv/videos/practical-engineering-why-the-levees-failed-in-new-orleans

Signed copies of my first book (plus other cool stuff) are available here: https://store.practical.engineering/
